correctness.rationale: The exact published ten-point cover incidences determine all order automorphisms. Layer-fixed cases I--III yield C2, S3 and V4 by explicit degree and neighborhood invariants; the omission graph controls IV--VII with colored graphs C4+2K1, P5+K1, P5+K1 and P4+P2. Their part-preserving groups are V4, C2, C2, 1, and Type VII has one part-swapping involution. Standalone exhaustive permutation enumeration and separately implemented directed-cover-graph isomorphism yield the same 7 counts and 4 anti counts. The lower bound uses cited nine-point classification and the nontrivial group of the canonical nine-point Rival model. The conclusion does not assert uniqueness among nonminimal ten-point models.

value.rationale: Determines the smallest finite weakly contractible noncontractible rigid space, a natural size-minimization question distinct from generic weak homotopy. Gives complete exact homeomorphism-group classification across every minimal example at cardinality ten; the omission graph provides a transferable structural interpretation and identifies the counterintuitive unique order-reversing involution on an otherwise rigid space.
